title: int:Order
description: A single buy (bid) or sell (offer) order submission to a market slot. Subclass of cim:MarketFactors. Mirrors the Rust EwdsOrderDto (camelCase wire form; RFC 3339 timestamps).

orderId.description: Non-zero bytes16 as UUID, 0x-prefixed hex or bare hex. Lifecycle notifications use lowercase 0x hex; rejections echo the submission. IRI: int:orderId.

marketId.description: Non-zero market ID as UUID, 0x-prefixed hex or bare hex. IRI: int:marketId.

orderType.description: Buy or sell order. IRI: int:orderType.

orderStatus.description: Lifecycle status of this order. IRI: int:orderStatus. Incoming order.event submissions must be submitted; orderStatus.event notifications can report any listed status. Rejected submissions are notified without storing a rejected order.

timeSlot.description: Target delivery timeslot. IRI: int:timeSlot. RFC 3339 with timezone.

quantity.description: Energy quantity in kWh. IRI: int:quantity. Unit: kWh. Must be > 0.

priceLimit.description: Price limit in EUR/kWh. IRI: int:priceLimit. Unit: EUR/kWh.

energySourcePreference.description: Preferred energy source type. IRI: int:energySourcePreference.

energyType.description: Energy type classification for this order. IRI: int:energyType.

createdBy.description: Facility identity, not its owner or submitting service wallet. Submissions and rejection echoes use the off-chain identity; indexed lifecycle notifications use its lowercase 0x bytes16 hash. IRI: int:createdby.

creationTime.description: Order creation datetime. IRI: int:createdAt. RFC 3339 with timezone.

updatedAt.description: Order last updated datetime. IRI: int:updatedAt. RFC 3339 with timezone. Nullable.

rejectReason.description: Human-readable reject/cancellation reason. IRI: int:rejectionReason. Populated when orderStatus = cancelled or rejected. Nullable.

preferredTradingPartner.description: Off-chain facility identity of the preferred counterparty of a bid or offer, taken from the requirements. Hex-shaped strings are still off-chain identities, not resolved hashes. IRI: int:preferredTradingPartner. Nullable.

preferredEnergyRate.description: Preferred bilateral energy rate in EUR/kWh. IRI: int:preferredEnergyRate. Nullable.
